title: SAML 2.0 support (GSoC 2013) and the saml add-on
description: The 2013 SAML project in the Student Hall of Fame and the history of the saml add-on in zap-extensions.

chapters.title: September 2013: initial code
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists SAML 2.0 support (Pulasthi Mahawithana) as a 2013 Summer GSoC project. The project page says the aim was to "develop a component for ZAP that will detect and fuzz various elements and attributes of a SAML Assertion" and lists pre-releases 0.1-alpha, 0.2-alpha and 1.0-alpha from July to September 2013. In zap-extensions, "Added SAML extension's initial code for alpha release" is dated 2013-09-05.

chapters.title: Follow-up commits
chapters.text: Commits in the following weeks include "Fixed some bugs, and cleaned up the code" (2013-09-19), "Did some UI fixes to saml extension and added missing documentation" (2013-09-21) and "I18N, Bug and UI fixes, added to ant build" (2013-09-29).

chapters.title: 2018 to now
chapters.text: "saml: remove unnecessary library (#1572)" is dated 2018-05-01 and "saml: relocate to its own project" 2019-04-03. The add-on is still in zap-extensions; a commit touching it dated 2026-08-28 is titled "saml: Update settings button title capitalization".
